provenance.status: alpha2 candidate (0.2.0) locally runtime-verified 2026-09-10; source uncommitted/unpushed, not a published release
provenance.description: Independent desktop-sounds alpha 2 candidate. Reads original DND, lock, and idle state; passively observes the session notification bus for the supported agent-input contract; owns no notification service, popup, history, or UI.
provenance.referenceImplementation: Omarchy shell plugin conventions and gobijan.ui-sounds desktop-event filters; no notification implementation retained.

integrationFields.safetyReady: conservative presence and valid known fields of DND/lock/idle services + unlocked/nonidle/nonDND + real screen + settled startup
integrationFields.overlapBlocked: pluginRegistry.isEnabled('gobijan.ui-sounds') === true; unknown registry or unknown state => blocked
integrationFields.observerActive: safetyReady && controller.settingsReady && controller.enabled && controller.agentInputEnabled; independent of desktop activation, ui-sounds overlap, and desktop adapter readiness

agent-needs-input.wav.format: RIFF/WAVE, PCM 16-bit mono 44100 Hz, 0.385 s, peak 0.3
agent-needs-input.wav.synthesis: Original one-off eval synthesis: two sine tones E5 then A5 (~659.255 Hz then ~880 Hz), 170 ms each, 45 ms raised-cosine fades, 45 ms gap, peak 0.3. No embedded metadata. Project license: MIT (see license below).

verification.status: Alpha 2 (0.2.0) candidate locally runtime-verified in the installed Omarchy shell on 2026-09-10. Source is uncommitted/unpushed; GitHub currently publishes 0.1.0. No release was published, committed, or pushed. No host patch, system configuration, or service replacement was made.
sourceGates: qmllint -I /usr/lib/qt6/qml -W 0: all product QML/JS and service-safety.qml passed
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p observer_test.py: 36 tests passed
runtime: Installed candidate 0.2.0 actually loaded; original v1 settings migrated preserving enabled=true, volume=1, desktop=true, with the new agentInput switch initially false.
Owner chose to keep agentInputEnabled=true; final schema2 settings are enabled=true, volume=1, desktopEnabled=true, agentInputEnabled=true.
Real native Oh My Pi 18.1.16 ask triggered the local WAV player; on repeat ask the user confirmed 'Yes, heard it' (listening at volume 0.35; final original volume 1 restored).
Native process sampling capped at maximum 1; real preview bypassed mute and left saved settings unchanged; same-burst preview accepted one request and rejected two as busy.
Live mute and repeated mute cancelled a running preview; DND cancelled/blocks preview and deactivates the helper.
Invalid live v2 reload preserved mute and volume; rapid off/on helper recovered; automatic desktop-off did not cancel the agent cue; input-off cancelled the automatic cue.
Missing WAV/observer-file tests failed closed and the original notification ping still worked; files were restored.
Actual plugin disable removed audio/helper; re-enable with same-version file touch preserved settings, no burst, one helper.
Real foot open/close and Lua workspace 900 round trip mapped desktop assets; repeated current-workspace request was silent; original workspace 1 restored.
Live standalone observer smoke (13 cases: fresh/valid/stale-ID/unique-destination/classifier/suppression/reconnect) passed; synthetic IDs closed.
Actual owner-change test used dbus-run-session on a private bus: error owner-changed plus clean exit and restart with no replay; the real desktop notification owner was not changed by that fixture.
Isolated QML harness passed simulation of DND/lock/idle/missing/rebound services/overlap/helper lifecycle with a pre-created isolated XDG parent, not physical lock/unlock.
Deployment caveat verified: file atomic-replace plus disable/rescan/re-enable still loaded cached 0.1.0; after the user-authorized unlock and a NORMAL omarchy restart shell, 0.2.0 loaded.
Owner changed :1.12 -> :1.2240 ONLY at the authorized shell restart and remained :1.2240 across subsequent tests; notification ping still worked. Shell config JSON unchanged from the saved original.
Backup of the original plugin/settings is at ~/.local/state/omarchy/plugin-backups/chime-alpha1-3GSwhU (machine-specific).
verification.limitations: Physical audibility was confirmed only for the user's native ask, not for multi-monitor scenarios; multi-monitor coverage is deterministic tests only. Lock/idle transitions were simulated in the isolated QML harness, not physical lock/unlock. The real desktop notification owner was not changed by the private-bus owner-change fixture. Issue #4 approved ambiguous equal IDs as silent; agent-completed/generic notifications and a bar widget remain out of scope.
